NFR-07.description: Crash safety — every write fully committed or fully rolled back
NFR-07.evidence: definition/store.zig createDefinition uses a single parameterized INSERT...RETURNING inside a pool-acquired connection. ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING ensures atomicity on duplicate detection. Consistent with DB-03 (transactional integrity) verified at Stage 1.

sql_parameter_safety.evidence: INSERT uses $1=name, $2=version, $3=description, $4=graph, $5=created_by. SELECT queries use $1=id and $1=name/$2=version. No user data appears in any SQL string literal. Comment at store.zig:171 explicitly documents the security invariant.
